## Summary Build a server-rendered Node.js + Express habit tracker (EJS views, SQLite storage) that replaces the placeholder nginx image, serving `/habits`, `/habits/new`, and `/about` on port 8080 under the `/e2e-lane-enterprise` base path. ## Scope ### Files to modify - `Dockerfile` — replace the static-nginx placeholder with a Node 20 build that installs deps and runs the Express server on 8080. ### Files to create - `package.json` — declares deps (`express`, `ejs`, `better-sqlite3`), `start` script (`node src/server.js`), Node engine `>=20`. - `src/server.js` — Express app: view engine, static mount, `url()` helper via `BASE_PATH`, routes, health endpoints, listen on `0.0.0.0:8080`. - `src/db.js` — initializes SQLite, creates `habits` table, seeds 3 example habits when empty, exports query/insert helpers. - `views/layout.ejs` — shared HTML shell with ``, stylesheet link, page-content block. - `views/habits.ejs` — "My Habits" heading, habit rows (name + streak), "Add Habit" button. - `views/new.ejs` — form with "Name" field + "Create" button posting to create route. - `views/about.ejs` — static "About Habit Tracker" page. - `public/styles.css` — minimal system-font styling for list, button, form. - `.dockerignore` — excludes `node_modules`, `.git`, local db files. - `.gitignore` — ignores `node_modules`, `*.db`. ### Dependencies - `express` (HTTP + routing), `ejs` (server-rendered views), `better-sqlite3` (synchronous embedded SQLite). No external network services. ### Integrations - None (no third-party APIs, SDKs, or external services). ### Assumptions - **Stack chosen (greenfield):** repo is a bare template inviting replacement; Node 20 + Express + EJS + SQLite chosen for a single-container, low-memory, one-port fit consistent with the deployment quota and 8080 target. - **No auth:** spec explicitly declares "No authentication" — no login, roles, guards, or seeded admin. Health routes remain public. - **Base path:** app is served under `/e2e-lane-enterprise/`; ingress strips the prefix, so backend routes are root-relative (`/habits`) while all rendered links/forms/assets are prefixed via a `BASE_PATH` env var (default `/e2e-lane-enterprise`). Empty `BASE_PATH` supported for local dev. - **Persistence:** SQLite file at `./data/habits.db` (path via `DB_PATH` env). No PersistentVolume in the deployment, so data is ephemeral; seed-on-start guarantees `/habits` is never empty. - **Streak:** stored as integer `streak` (default 0); seeded habits get sample values (e.g. 5, 2, 0) since no check-in flow is specified. Create form collects only "Name". - **Server-rendered, not SPA:** each route is a real URL, satisfying URL-addressability without client routing or base-href hacks. ## Implementation Plan ### Step 1: Project manifest & dependencies **File:** `package.json` **Change:** Define `name`, `type: "commonjs"`, `engines.node: ">=20"`, `scripts.start: "node src/server.js"`, dependencies `express`, `ejs`, `better-sqlite3`. Enables reproducible container build. ### Step 2: Database layer + seeding **File:** `src/db.js` **Change:** Open SQLite at `process.env.DB_PATH || './data/habits.db'` (create parent dir if missing). Create table `habits (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, streak INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))`. On init, if `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM habits` is 0, insert 3 example rows (e.g. "Drink water" streak 5, "Read 20 minutes" streak 2, "Morning walk" streak 0). Export `listHabits()`, `addHabit(name)`, and a `ping()` for deep health. ### Step 3: Express app, base-path helper, routes **File:** `src/server.js` **Change:** - `const BASE = process.env.BASE_PATH || '/e2e-lane-enterprise'`; expose `res.locals.url = p => BASE + p` (used by all views for links/forms/assets). - Set `view engine = ejs`, views dir `views/`. - `express.static('public')` mounted so assets resolve at `${BASE}/static/...`; reference via `url('/static/styles.css')`. - `express.urlencoded({ extended: false })` for form posts. - Routes (root-relative — ingress already strips prefix): - `GET /` → redirect to `url('/habits')`. - `GET /habits` → render `habits` with `listHabits()`. - `GET /habits/new` → render `new`. - `POST /habits` → validate non-empty name, `addHabit(name)`, redirect to `url('/habits')`. - `GET /about` → render `about`. - Listen on `0.0.0.0:8080`. ### Step 4: Health endpoints **File:** `src/server.js` **Change:** `GET /api/health` → `200 {status:'ok'}`. `GET /api/health/deep` → run `db.ping()` (a trivial `SELECT 1`), return `200 {status:'ok',db:'ok'}` or `503` on failure. Supports pipeline smoke tests; kept public. ### Step 5: Views **Files:** `views/layout.ejs`, `views/habits.ejs`, `views/new.ejs`, `views/about.ejs` **Change:** - `layout.ejs`: ``, ``, ``, yields body content; simple nav linking Habits / About via `url()`. - `habits.ejs`: `

My Habits

`, loop rows showing `habit.name` and a streak counter (e.g. "🔥 <%= habit.streak %> day streak"), and a prominent `Add Habit`. - `new.ejs`: `
` with a labeled "Name" text input (`name="name"` required) and a ``. - `about.ejs`: `

About Habit Tracker

` plus a short static description. ### Step 6: Styling **File:** `public/styles.css` **Change:** System-font, centered max-width container, styled habit rows, a prominent `.btn`, and clean form layout. ### Step 7: Container build **File:** `Dockerfile` **Change:** Replace nginx placeholder. `FROM node:20-alpine`, `WORKDIR /app`, copy `package*.json`, `RUN npm install --omit=dev` (better-sqlite3 needs build toolchain — add `apk add --no-cache python3 make g++` before install, or use `node:20` slim with build deps; prefer `npm ci` if a lockfile is generated), copy source, create `/app/data`, `ENV BASE_PATH=/e2e-lane-enterprise PORT=8080`, `EXPOSE 8080`, `CMD ["node","src/server.js"]`. ### Step 8: Ignore files **Files:** `.dockerignore`, `.gitignore` **Change:** Exclude `node_modules`, `.git`, `data/`, `*.db` from image context and version control. ## Testing Strategy - **Seed:** start with empty/removed db → `GET /habits` shows exactly 3 seeded habits with names + streaks. - **List:** `/habits` renders heading "My Habits", one row per habit, and the "Add Habit" button. - **Add flow:** `GET /habits/new` shows Name field + Create button; POST a name → 302 back to `/habits`; new habit appears (streak 0). - **About:** `/about` shows "About Habit Tracker" heading. - **No auth:** every route reachable with no login/cookie. - **Base path:** hit `https://ubuntu.desmana-truck.ts.net/e2e-lane-enterprise/habits`; confirm nav links, "Add Habit", form action, and CSS all resolve under the prefix (no 404s). - **Health:** `GET /api/health` → 200; `/api/health/deep` → 200 with db ok. - **Container:** `docker build` succeeds; container listens on 8080 and serves `/habits`. ## Risks - **Ephemeral data:** no PersistentVolume — visitor-added habits are lost on pod restart; seeded 3 reappear each start. Mitigation if persistence needed: mount a PVC at `DB_PATH`. - **better-sqlite3 native build:** requires build toolchain in the image; if the alpine build proves fragile, switch base to `node:20-slim` (Debian) or swap to `node:sqlite`/`sql.js`. Verify build in CI. - **Base-path correctness:** any hard-coded root-relative URL missed in a view will 404 behind the ingress; the `url()` helper must be used everywhere. - **Single replica downtime:** `Recreate` strategy causes a few seconds of downtime on deploy — acceptable for staging.
